In Round 2 of the Asian Nations Chess Cup 2026, the Indian Women's team faced Mongolia. On the top board, WGM Munkhzul Turmunkh played against IM Vantika Agrawal. Thinking she would receive an extra 30 minutes after move 40, Munkhzul left the board on her 41st move, only to return and discover she had lost on time.
Check out the final moments of the game and our post-match interview with Vantika!
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Devansh Singh
